sum: Euroseas Ltd. provides ocean-going transportation services in Greece and internationally. The company owns and operates containerships that transport dry and refrigerated containerized cargoes, including manufactured products and perishables. As of April 15, 2026, it had a fleet of 21 containerships, including 15 Feeder containerships and 6 Intermediate containerships with a cargo of 61,144 TEU. Euroseas Ltd. is based in Marousi, Greece.
ceo: Mr. Aristides J. Pittas (Chairman, CEO & President)
